dominant_strengths: Clean dark interface reduces visual noise for focused task management
Clear status indicators and tags provide functional categorization
Minimal approach prevents feature bloat common in PM tools
dominant_weaknesses: Severe contrast issues make text barely readable against dark background
No visual hierarchy between title, description, and metadata creates scanning difficulty
Generic card design lacks any project management-specific affordances or innovation
fix_priorities: Increase text contrast to WCAG AA standards for basic legibility
Establish typographic hierarchy with distinct title/body/meta styles
Add PM-specific visual elements like progress bars, dependencies, or timeline views
Introduce subtle color coding system for priority/status beyond basic tags
rationale.norman_balance: Design fails viscerally with poor readability, provides basic behavioral function through tags/status, but lacks reflective depth or memorable PM experience.
rationale.intent_fit: While technically a project management interface with tasks and status tracking, it's too generic and poorly executed to effectively serve PM workflows.
